selector.legacy: Existing World constructor default; no model preload.
selector.virtualFoot: Explicit --import ./scripts/diag/enable-virtual-foot.ts; modifies only supportModel before calling the original World.step.
selector.note: No observer or controller wrapper is inserted by this runner. Existing script bodies, RNG and command cadence are unchanged.

limitations: The virtual-foot mode is the existing experimental averaged coordinate, not the proposed two persistent support slots.
Finer solver runs are numerical convergence references, not empirical football truth.
Shared-capability constant-intent probes and real-technique scenario probes answer different questions.
Single sequential wall timings are descriptive and include process startup; they do not establish production overhead or speedup.
Known finite baseline regressions are retained as observations, not treated as execution failures.

measured.note: Both models explicitly selected by this script. Initial COMs are still, then free. Grip impulse is the sum of actual solved per-joint impulse magnitudes, recovered from tick-average force times dt; it is not a net vector impulse. Foot maxima are tick samples, not continuous peaks.

syntheticDrift.note: Directly resets support deviation before each stationary recovery. No collisions, impulses or physical-hit work; lifecycle geometry diagnostic only.
